documents.content: TargetCo Inc. is a Delaware C-corporation. Outstanding shares: 1,000,000 common. Board: five directors. No convertible notes outstanding as of the latest balance sheet date.
Master Services Agreement with Customer A: 24-month term, auto-renewal unless notice is given 90 days prior, termination for convenience with 60 days written notice.
FY2025 revenue $4.2M, gross margin 61%, operating margin 12%. Recurring revenue share is 78% of total revenue.
